content.comment_body: Hello! I am experiencing an issue with the analog output from [product_name], aiming to write 0-10 Volt to a damper actuator. I would also like to have a matching input (0-10 Volt) that adjusts the output. Additionally, is it possible to output 0-130 Ohm, regulated by 0-10 Volt? Is this achievable? Kind regards [user_name]
No, analog voltage output only supports a larger minimum resistance. Typically, the minimum resistance is around 1000 to 10000 Ohm depending on the specifications.
So, you’re saying I can’t use an actuator like the one in the attachment? That’s unfortunate—I’ll need to look for another solution.
The attached document shows a possible actuator example from another manufacturer.

That’s one of the actuators we use—how do I obtain output variation between 0-10 Volt from the [product_name] unit? I’ve read several forum posts and tutorials in [product_name] V8, but haven’t found a clear explanation yet. Can I link this function to a PT100 temperature sensor? Thank you so much for your help—this is very interesting and I’m still learning daily! // [user_name]

You need to assign values to the analog output: 0 to 1000 units, where 0 = 0V and 1000 = 10V. This lets you adjust between 0.00 V and 10.00 V. If you’d like to use a PT100/1000 sensor with the controller, you will need an analog input module like [product_name].

I have the analog input module for Pt100/1000 sensors, but I haven’t managed to design the circuit diagram to control the analog output with either sensor feedback or using up/down buttons on the operator display. I think I can sort out the button logic, but connecting the sensor for automatic regulation still needs work… // [user_name]
Here’s a simple program that provides the basic requirements. The setpoint value can be adjusted directly from the display.
Thank you! You’ve really helped me out today! I might be back soon with more questions. Thanks again! // [user_name]
You’re welcome! Feel free to ask as many questions as you need.

analysis.insight_summary: The main technical challenge is controlling a damper actuator using a [product_name] analog output, regulated either by a 0-10V input or temperature sensor feedback. The user is unclear about hardware output limitations, especially the minimum required resistive load. There’s confusion on linking sensor input to analog output, and the available documentation and tutorials are insufficient for this use case, leaving questions about both hardware compatibility and software configuration in [product_name] V8.
analysis.user_expectations: User hopes for a straightforward solution to regulate a damper actuator with a 0-10V signal, controlled by external input or sensor feedback. They are seeking clear instructions or documentation for hardware and software setup, including guidance on automatic regulation using temperature sensors.
